name: kaizhar
title: Kaizhar
author: wowilookgood; Azahar by the Azahar Emulator Project
description: An unofficial Switch 2 port of the Azahar 3DS emulator.
details:
Kaizhar runs your own 3DS game dumps on a Switch 2 running kaiHEN. No games are included.

Features:
- Five screen layouts, all drawn at 4x the 3DS's resolution
- 120 Hz in handheld mode
- Touch with a finger, a Joy-Con as a mouse, or the right stick as a pointer
- Local wireless play through rooms
- Online play through Pretendo, set up once with your own 3DS
- Decrypted .cia files install from the title list

Put your dumps in /switch/Kaizhar/roms. Report problems to Kaizhar's repository, not to the Azahar project.
changelog: 2126.2-kaizhar3: local wireless play through rooms, online play through Pretendo, a Settings page, 120 Hz in handheld mode, every layout at 4x, smoother first launches.
